quiensoy.p1: I'm Brayan Albadam, a digital designer student from Universidad Politécnico Grancolombiano with UX certifications from Google and user experience and consumer design from Universidad San Buenaventura Cali, complemented by web application development studies from Universidad Industrial de Santander.
quiensoy.p2: My work combines design and development: I have built brand identities for companies and professionals, developed WordPress interfaces, and led the user experience on an educational platform in CANVAS LMS for farmers in Central America, where design was key to overcoming accessibility and technology adoption barriers.
quiensoy.p3: As Project Manager on a project with the Ministry of TICs, Apps.CO and Universidad ICESI, I coordinated design and development teams to deliver 74 MVPs in Cycle 2 of the Apps.Co Project — Digital Product Phase, meeting deadlines and quality standards.
quiensoy.p4: I was a semifinalist in the contest for the brand redesign of the Felipe Ángeles International Airport in Mexico and participated in Bancolombia's Bank Design 2023 challenge — two experiences that tested my judgment under real pressure.
quiensoy.p5: I apply Design Thinking to uncover real problems, translate them into clear solutions, and build experiences people genuinely want to use.
